user.title: ZverTBot VPS connection
user.description:
Choose how to connect to the VPS.

Use existing tunnel — choose this option if an SSH tunnel to the VPS is already configured on Home Assistant. The integration uses the existing tunnel and does not create its own SSH connection.

Create SSH connection — choose this option if the integration should connect to the VPS directly over SSH. You can use an existing SSH key or create a new key specifically for this integration.

tunnel.title: Use existing tunnel
tunnel.description: The integration uses the SSH tunnel already configured on Home Assistant to the VPS. No separate SSH connection is created.

ssh.title: Create SSH connection
ssh.description: The integration establishes the SSH connection to the VPS itself. Specify the VPS IP address, SSH port, and username. On the next step, you can choose an existing SSH key or create a new one.

ssh_key.title: SSH key usage
ssh_key.description: Choose how the SSH key should be used for the SSH connection created by the integration.

ssh_key_create.title: Create SSH key
ssh_key_create.description: A new Ed25519 key will be created inside Home Assistant. The private key will be stored at the selected path and never displayed.

ssh_key_public.title: SSH key created
ssh_key_public.description:
The private key was saved to {key_path}.

Add this public key to /root/.ssh/authorized_keys on the VPS:

{public_key}

Then continue to test the connection.

ssh_key_existing.title: Existing SSH key
ssh_key_existing.description: Specify the path to an existing private SSH key inside Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the VPS or read its status.
error.invalid_response: The VPS returned an invalid ZverTBot status response.
